description: A re-issued attempt reuses the broken attempt's id
new: /\ currentId' = IF currentId = 0 THEN nextId ELSE currentId

description: A tools/call is re-sent after a broken stream
Broken streams are re-issued past the attempt limit

old:
/\ IF a = "mismatch" /\ kind = "call" /\ headerRetries = 0
          THEN /\ phase' = "relisting"
               /\ headerRetries' = 1
new:
/\ IF a = "mismatch" /\ kind = "call" /\ headerRetries <= 1
          THEN /\ phase' = "relisting"
               /\ headerRetries' = headerRetries + 1

description: An answer that arrives after a cancel is delivered
Every lost request is flagged as maybe run
An answered attempt's stream is left open
old: /\ closed' = TRUE    \* nothing more comes for the answered attempt

description: A listing whose answer was over the message limit is re-issued like a broken stream
old:
/\ phase' = "lost"
    /\ maybeRan' = (kind = "call")
    /\ Deliver("lost")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<kind, attempts, headerRetries, currentId, nextId, closed, usedIds, reused, cancelNote>>
new:
/\ IF kind = "idempotent" /\ attempts < MaxAttempts
          THEN /\ attempts' = attempts + 1
               /\ Post
               /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, maybeRan, delivered>>
          ELSE /\ phase' = "lost"
               /\ maybeRan' = (kind = "call")
               /\ Deliver("lost")
               /\ UNCHANGED <<attempts, currentId, nextId, closed, usedIds, reused>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<kind, headerRetries, cancelNote>>
